classification.difficultyReason: Identify translated-circle centres and radii, calculate exact intercepts and construct labelled sketches, including tangency.

content.prompt: Sketch the graphs, showing the $x$- and $y$-intercepts.

answer.worked:
Centre $(1,2)$ and radius $2$.

For the $x$-intercept, put $y=0$:
$$\begin{align*}(x-1)^2+(0-2)^2&=4\\(x-1)^2&=0\\x&=1\end{align*}$$
For the $y$-intercepts, put $x=0$:
$$\begin{align*}(0-1)^2+(y-2)^2&=4\\(y-2)^2&=3\\y-2&=\pm\sqrt3\\y&=2\pm\sqrt3\end{align*}$$
The circle touches the $x$-axis at $(1,0)$.

spec.description: Unfilled circle with labelled centre and all intercepts; tangent to the horizontal axis.

answer.worked:
Centre $(2,3)$ and radius $3$.

Put $y=0$:
$$\begin{align*}(x-2)^2+(0-3)^2&=9\\(x-2)^2&=0\\x&=2\end{align*}$$
Put $x=0$:
$$\begin{align*}(0-2)^2+(y-3)^2&=9\\(y-3)^2&=5\\y-3&=\pm\sqrt5\\y&=3\pm\sqrt5\end{align*}$$
The circle touches the $x$-axis at $(2,0)$.

$$\begin{align*}(x-1)^2+0^2&=4\\x-1&=\pm2\\x&=-1\text{ or }3\end{align*}$$
Put $x=0$:
$$\begin{align*}(0-1)^2+y^2&=4\\y^2&=3\\y&=\pm\sqrt3\end{align*}$$
Sketch a circle centred at $(1,0)$ through these four intercepts.
